# MenuBoost — AI Menu Description Generator

## What is MenuBoost?
MenuBoost is an AI-powered tool that generates professional menu descriptions for restaurants in 10 languages. Users photograph their menu or enter dishes manually, choose a writing style, and get appetizing descriptions instantly.

## Key Features
- Photograph menu → AI extracts dish names → generates descriptions
- 10 languages: Slovenian, English, German, Italian, Croatian, Serbian, French, Spanish, Turkish, Greek
- 6 writing styles: Poetic, Classic, Simple, Delivery, Social, Michelin
- Mobile-first PWA (installable on phones)
- €19/month unlimited plan, 3 free dishes trial

## Who is it for?
Restaurants, cafes, tourist farms, pizzerias, bars, hotels — any food service business that needs professional menu descriptions in multiple languages.

## How it works
1. User photographs their paper menu or uploads a photo
2. AI (Gemma 4) extracts dish names from the image
3. User selects writing style and target languages
4. AI (DeepSeek) generates appetizing descriptions
5. User copies descriptions to their menu

## Pricing
- Free: 3 dishes with descriptions
- Pro: €19/month for unlimited dishes, all languages, all styles
